name: OCEN Loan Application
description: Tracks the OCEN 4.0 async journey stage for one LOS-side loan application (spec §6.2, §6.3). As of ADR 0005 this app runs on its own Frappe site, separate from the LOS — loan_application/tenant_id are plain strings, not Frappe Links, since the referenced records live in a different database. This DocType is written to by ocen_connector.api.integration (on submission) and ocen_connector.api.webhooks (on inbound OCEN callbacks), not directly by end users.

fields.label: LOS Loan Application ID
fields.description: The LOS site's Loan Application name/ID. No referential integrity across the site boundary — the API contract (ocen_connector.api.integration.submit_loan_application) is what keeps this correct, not the database.

fields.label: Tenant Code
fields.description: Informational mirror of the LOS-side tenant_id, for filtering/debugging only — not a Frappe User Permission-enforced boundary on this site. Tenant-scoped access control stays a LOS-side concern; callers to this site's API authenticate as a service account, not as individual borrowers/field agents.

fields.label: FLDG Cover (mirrored from LOS)
fields.description: Mirrored from the LOS Loan Application at submission time. CGTMSE and FLDG are mutually exclusive (spec §1.4) — OCEN Offer's controller checks this local mirror rather than querying the LOS site's database directly, which isn't possible across the site boundary.

fields.label: Request ID
fields.description: requestId sent on the initiating POST /v4/loanApplications call.

fields.label: OCEN Application ID
fields.description: application_id assigned by the OCEN network once acknowledged.
